text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah! Today marks the wrap-up of summer 
camp!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It was the best summer ever, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yeah~. But I'm already totally exhausted~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I really put my partner through a 
lot. Having them coordinate all kinds of 
training for me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“With this kind of conditioning, the 
『Kikuka Sho』 is totally doable! Now that 
you've got this much stamina, that is!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Dants?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing! You're right, I'm sure 
it'll work out somehow...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If only I can run through the Kikuka-sho 
in full health...
Just then...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm, you're...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am Air Messiah. Um... I wanted to 
formally offer my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help back then, 
Pocket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't sweat it. Helping out is just 
common sense.

Air Messiah, who Jungle Pocket saved 
during that ghost scare, came all the way 
out here just to say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: More importantly, um...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You'll be alright today, right? You're the 
real Messiah... right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, it is me. Therefore, these 
feelings of gratitude are genuine as well.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yeah. That's true. I don't really 
know what happened back then, though...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's no way ghosts actually exist! 
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's true, as expected, right♪

The three of them laughed merrily. 
However...
I won't let you pass... beyond this point.

I will... never forgive you. —I... CANNOT 
forgive you.

From the distant shade of the trees in the 
night's gloom... I felt as though someone 
was watching our every move.
